items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I went to school with Emile Labat.

ctx.x: [Following a break, the recording resumes in mid-sentence.]

. . . be tangled up in whatever they had. It wasn’t too scientific. Mr. Medard would straighten them up. People come there, he’s busy all the time. Come there with lawsuit problems. They came to Mr. Medard to get some advice. He had two sons who taught. They come out of college. They had two daughters. I went to school with Emile Labat. You remember Emile Labat?
